name: selftest
description: Validates every tools/*/tool.json manifest (required fields, entrypoint exists, run path resolves, schema-v2 fields) and runs each tool's declared smoke test under tests/. Use after adding or changing a tool.
use_when: verifying all tools work after adding or changing them

args.name: --only
args.description: Run validation and smoke for a single tool directory name.

args.name: --manifests-only
args.description: Validate manifests without running smoke tests.

stdout: JSON report: {ok, valid, invalid, smoke_pass, smoke_fail, no_smoke}.

exit_codes.0: all manifests valid and all smokes passed
